decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (23, 24, and 25; dated October 2015, received 14/10/2015) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 1995 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/buildings within the curtilage of the site shall be carried out.

Condition : 5 - The window pane which faces No. 46 Eton Avenue in the first floor bay window on the front elevation of the extension hereby permitted, shall be obscure glazed and non-opening and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 6 - The extensions hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 46A Eton Avenue and the dwelling shall not be subdivided without the approval of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Increase in roof height and a rear roof extension with front roof windows, erection of a two storey rear and single storey front and side extensions to the house
